pergunta: in the 16 g10b2 cells (bauru/campinas/lins/sorocaba x Q1..Q4), across the 20 split_seeds of C-1, what is the fraction of nodes with a valid target (1-pi, pi = rf_targets[:,0] < 299.0) in the TRAINING, VALIDATION and TEST partitions after the buffer? Does the 15/16 (validation poorer than training, seed 42) survive as a law or become a distribution? And the 12/16 (test richer than training), now with the 16 cells?

portao_validacao.descricao: seed 42, exact split (cKDTree), reproduction of particoes.<papel>.frac_pl_alvo_valido in the 16 g10b2 cells x 3 roles (48 comparisons)

pi_validacao_definicao.definicao: rf_targets[:,0] < 299.0 (PL_TARGET_MAX_VALID), equivalent to col0<299 -- already validated and selected in C-1 over col4 (definition discarded); frac_valida = 1 - pi

criterios_fixados.definicao_literal: 'law' if (i) k_val(s) = #cells with frac_val < frac_treino >= 12/16 in >= 18 of the 20 seeds AND (ii) in >= 12/16 cells the mean over seeds of delta_val = frac_val - frac_treino is negative with a bootstrap 95% CI over the 20 seeds (10000 resamples, fixed bootstrap seed) excluding 0. Otherwise 'distribution'. Same criterion with the sign reversed for the test set (delta_te = frac_teste - frac_treino > 0). Fixed before the sweep was run (R3-a task statement).

resumo.aviso_dependencia: Q1=Q2 and Q3=Q4 share the geometry (extensao_x_km/extensao_y_km identical within each pair -- checked in the run JSONs), so the same split_seed produces the SAME group permutation (same geometric pattern of train/val/test blocks) in both members of the pair; the 16 cells are NOT 16 independent observations with respect to split-draw geometry (the valid fraction itself differs, since the terrain/PL target is different). See agregado_por_geometria_8, k_val_por_seed_geometria_8, k_te_por_seed_geometria_8 for the conservative reading with 8 units.

executado: gate: 16 g10b2 cells x 3 roles = 48 comparisons, seed 42, exact split (cKDTree)
sweep: 16 cells x 20 seeds, g10b2, EDT method (same method and same EDT-vs-cKDTree validation already documented in C-1)
aggregation by cell (16) and by geometry (8)
decision criterion fixed before the run, applied to val (15/16) and test (12/16)
fora_do_escopo: g5b2 in the 16 cells (did not fit the ~40min budget of this short round; g10b2 prioritized as specified)
(g,b) 6x6 grid (outside the scope of this deliverable, already partially covered by C-1)

Effective N under within-partition spatial autocorrelation: out of scope (belongs to the spatial-leakage analysis); here the sampling unit of the inference (bootstrap CI, k(s)) is the split_seed (20 observations, each a COMPLETE partition of the node population), not the pixel -- within-partition spatial autocorrelation does not inflate N here because frac_valida is a POPULATION PARAMETER of the whole partition under that seed, not a sample mean of pixels; the real dependence of this inference is BETWEEN CELLS that share geometry (Q1=Q2, Q3=Q4), handled explicitly via agregado_por_geometria_8.
